text:
Jordan: Heads-up — midweek metric anomaly: webinar landing CTR down ~20% over the last 48h. dashboard: https://redwood.app/dash/marketing/webinar-ctr
Priya: saw that. is the drop across paid + organic or isolated to one channel?
Jordan: mostly LinkedIn paid; organic has a small dip. CPAs look stable but fewer leads are attributed.
Marco: we swapped creative on Monday but click volume stayed similar. creative change unlikely to be the cause. any tracking changes?
Emily: flagging — GA4 UTM normalization was rolled from staging to prod yesterday; could be collapsing `utm_campaign` variants. investigating.
analytics-bot: deploy: dashboard-v12 promoted to prod by @ops-bot — 2025-10-18 16:05 UTC
Sam: that deploy might have touched the ingestion/normalization job. @Emily any quick logs or counts?
Emily: ran a quick query:
```
SELECT source, count(*) FROM leads WHERE event_time > now() - interval '2 days' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC;
```
results show ~12% of previously `linkedin/cpc` leads now classified as `direct`.
Priya: that explains the apparent LinkedIn CTR drop — the leads are present but reclassified.
Lina: ok — reclassification could interact with Lead Router rules (direct vs linkedin). if router treats `direct` differently we might have routing/deduping side-effects.
Jordan: plan of attack: 1) Emily validate UTM normalization changes and surface which fields were altered (owner: Emily, ETA 2h). 2) Sam inspect ingestion logs and evaluate rollback or pause of normalization (owner: Sam, ETA 1h). 3) Lina confirm Lead Router mapping/filters for `source='direct'` vs `source='linkedin'` (owner: Lina, ETA 3h). 4) Priya run validation sample and assist with guardrail tweaks (owner: Priya, ETA 3h).
Marco: if rollback isn't possible can we patch the dashboard to prefer `raw_campaign` for the next 24h as a stopgap?
Emily: `raw_campaign` exists; sample patch:
```
CASE WHEN raw_campaign IS NOT NULL THEN raw_campaign ELSE utm_campaign END
```
Sam: ingest logs show the normalization job ran at 2025-10-18T16:02Z — same window as the dashboard deploy. I've paused the normalization job and queued a reprocess for yesterday's batch. will update status here.
Jordan: good. this looks like noisy attribution rather than lost leads. we'll notify sales if routing gaps surface.
Lina: also noticed a couple of webhook duplicate notifications yesterday — could be downstream dedupe settings that we should inspect while reprocessing.
Emily: reprocess queued; if successful numbers should align within ~30-60m.
analytics-bot: job: normalization-pause succeeded (triggered by @sam) — 2025-10-18 16:42 UTC
Priya: after reprocess I'll run a validation on a sample of 200 leads to confirm `source` parity between raw and processed data.
Jordan: owners/ETAs recap pinned above. please react with :thumbsup: once you've accepted.
Marco: :thumbsup:
Emily: :thumbsup:
Sam: :thumbsup:
Lina: :thumbsup:
Priya: :thumbsup:
Jordan: thanks — reconvene in ~2h in #marketing for a status update. if anything spikes, ping @oncall-data.
